output_capture.claim: bounded virtual sink monitor capture only; no physical sound or continuity qualification
output_capture.limitation: pw-record exited 1 after ten seconds; retained exit, decoded PCM file and active sink monitor links independently; not a continuity pass

fixture.daw_processing_blocks: variable extents no greater than 1024; not uniformly 1024

no_plugin_baseline.claim: No bridge audio claim. The baseline itself retains one Ardour node error and one virtual input driver error.

instrument_admission_interpretation.observation: Native SDK input witness records a note-off outside its host block. The current contract rejects it. It is a distinct cause of permanent instrument refusal, not an explanation of preceding gaps or the effect gaps. No offset was clamped or rewritten.

outer_resource_bracket.note: Separate outer bracket includes setup before the 610-second loop monitor; no per-gap CPU attribution.

interpretation: The 610.32-second visual loop observation completed without owner exit, but an alive Windows process did not establish native processing health.

Effect: 38919168 admitted processing frames, 677464 missing frames in 263 gaps. Instrument: 1875968 admitted processing frames, 183296 missing in 56 gaps before permanent input refusal; 37043200 later rejected silent frames across 46184 rejected callbacks.

Both owner retirements were confirmed with no remaining leases. Instrument native lifecycle reports clean=false because its processing had failed; positive process cleanup does not make its lifecycle pass.
A 480000-frame stereo sink-monitor capture is entirely zero. Recorder exited 1; file contents, exact length and active source links were independently verified. No sound or continuity pass follows.
A direct four-channel DAW-output probe failed to obtain four capture ports and terminated only its own recorder. No result from that attempted probe is claimed.

The new snapshot contains no managed state envelope for the failed instrument. Its effect envelope is present. The new snapshot is a failure artifact, not successful save or recall evidence. Every pre-existing snapshot stayed unchanged.

No-plugin baseline and combined run retain their PipeWire node errors. Node counters observed on the first running snapshot may predate monitoring; they are not attributed to a new error during the observed interval.
Ardour emitted 9255 dropped-event warnings; their source is not yet attributed. The earlier no-plugin baseline also emitted dropped-event warnings.

The graph stayed at 48000/1024 when the bounded sink-monitor capture joined it. The whole native processing lifetime includes setup, loop, snapshot and closure; counters are not scoped solely to the observation window.
This run changes the audio backend and CPU fixture compared with internal55 PulseAudio. It does not uniquely explain internal54 or the Deck gaps and is not a corrected beta candidate.

capture_reference.purpose: Request the selected sink monitor instead of a source; actual active links retained.

guest_cpu_limit_readback.interpretation: Temporary two-core guest setting did not survive the intervening build/reboot cycle. This run had two virtual CPUs and a two-core outer cap, but only one core of guest user-slice quota; it is not a fully two-core workload comparison.
